name: l2cap_disconnect_channel

ownership.argument: Called by the stock channel disconnect handler after its own channel lookup. Dispatches on the channel's state byte and closes it with stock ownership: it emits callback event 6, frees the channel allocation and releases host link resources. Astrolink invokes it directly on the Bluelet owner with policy 9 so a queued disconnect cannot be blocked by module heap pressure, and never sends an ACL disconnect or touches companion/audio tables.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 image/IDB recovery recorded in EVID-ASTROLINK-4155-BLE-001 and docs/ble-abi.md: the policy the stock disconnect handler calls after its channel lookup. Recorded late so the target pack and the module verifier allowlist cover it.

notes: Audited .155 policy invoked with event 9 by Astrolink on the Bluelet owner. Static evidence only; the .155 module behaviour was validated before this record existed and is unchanged by it.
